name: US inflation
summary: US CPI rose 0.4% in October, above forecasts; annual rate near 4.1% by index, rising for three months
state: Consumer prices rose 0.4% in October and core prices 0.3%, both above forecasts, in data released on 10 Nov; food, rent, transport and energy all rose (Yahoo Finance). BLS gave no official annual rate because October 2025 data are missing after last year's shutdown; the FRED index puts it near 4.1%, up for a third month, inside the 3–4.5% Watch band. Brent was near $92 on 10 Nov, 13% lower than a month earlier.
for_you: Higher US inflation tends to keep interest rates high worldwide, which affects mortgage and loan costs, and makes US-priced goods and travel dearer.
rubric_hit: CPI ~4.1% within 3.0–4.5% Watch band; rising 3 consecutive months

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — October CPI inflation comes in hotter than expected as food and rent costs spike
FRED — Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPIAUCSL)

why: Inflation sets Fed policy and thus global borrowing costs; a resurgence would keep rates high for everyone.
drivers: Energy, tariffs, wages, housing costs, supply chains.

rubric.watch: CPI 3.0–4.5%, or rising for 3 consecutive months.
